本轮过程记录

Repair round 2 addressed the browser-QA failures observed in verify-2 for the Chinese device after-sales service and inspection application. Fixes: a missing auth guard caused GET /service-engineers 500; the client referenced 371 service.* translation keys that did not exist (new service-en/service-zh locale modules spread into en-US/zh-CN with compile-time parity); collaborator and observer access rules were corrected server- and client-side (an observer now reads the non-confidential register with laborHours/internalCost masked and no write path, including attachment upload/delete); createOne calls now write timestamps so POST /service-customers and /service-devices no longer 500; order transitions write a createdAt so the history no longer errors; uploads validate size/type/signature and surface the real reason; assistant references JSON is parsed; the dashboard gained region/priority filters plus region and engineer distributions; a scheduler-based recurring inspection/order-overdue provider replaced a private cron manager and the weekly plan frequency was corrected; automatic acceptance now records its steps in the order history with retained failures and idempotent retry; a new seed adds the missing regional/collaborator/observer roles, service teams with a workspace-selectable subject type and inheritance, order collaborations (including a confidential one that stays invisible), the order recovery example and in-box messages. All checks (format, lint, three typechecks, 309 tests) pass; db apply and the seed were validated on a fresh database, and a standalone boot confirmed the three schedules sync, team inheritance resolves without a direct role, and the observer/collaborator/coordinator record scopes behave as intended. Repair round 3 addressed the verify-3 browser-QA defects. Group 1: POST /service-devices no longer writes an explicit null into the NOT NULL service_devices.category column when the form leaves Category blank, so the database default applies and the create succeeds; the values assembly was extracted as deviceCreateValues and covered by tests/logic/service-device-create.test.ts. Group 2: every application Select root now passes items so the closed trigger and form dropdowns render translated labels instead of raw stored values (customer id, running status, order priority/source, and the all/__all__ filter sentinels); the missing service.level.basic value was added to SERVICE_LEVELS and both service locale files; and server-side rejections were moved from hard-coded Chinese to request-locale keys via server/services/errors.ts plus typed server/locales en-US/zh-CN, covered by tests/logic/server-error-locale.test.ts. The relevant self-tests (device-create, server-error-locale, locale-coverage, client-routes), Prettier, ESLint and all three typechecks pass. Repair round 4 addressed the verify-4 browser-QA failures around cross-region knowledge sharing and the inspection execution view. Group 1: migration 202609010007 adds the application-owned knowledge_shares table (articleId, teamId, teamName, region, reason, grantedById, grantedByName, active, revokedAt, timestamps, unique articleId+teamId) and an inspection_plans.timezone column; server/routes/knowledge.ts now resolves the caller's service-team memberships (Caller.teamIds), keeps a restricted article to coordinators, its author and explicitly shared teams, exposes GET /knowledge-share-teams, GET/POST /knowledge-articles/:id/shares and POST .../shares/:shareId/revoke, and returns canShare per row; the knowledge page gained a cross-region share dialog with per-team revoke. Group 2: the inspection page shows each plan's timezone and the plan form edits it, and a new 'Schedules & history' tab reads GET /api/schedules and GET /api/schedules/:id/occurrences (enable/disable via POST) so the schedule name, cron, timezone, enable state, next/last run, run counts and each execution's status/reason/start/finish/result are visible. Seed 202609010008 turns the catch-all '华东区域通用设备周巡检' into a daily plan (the root cause of 'Generated 0 task(s)' and a newly added device producing no task), backfills plan timezones, grants page:scheduler.schedules access plus settings:scheduler.schedules read to every permission set that reaches the inspection page, seeds one worked cross-region share to ST-SOUTH, and corrects the matching in-app notice. The article-visibility rule was extracted into server/services/knowledge.ts and planDueOn exported for test; new tests/logic/knowledge-sharing.test.ts and tests/logic/inspection-schedule.test.ts cover coordinator/author/team access, revocation, customer/integrator exclusion, catch-all daily coverage and the weekly non-Monday gap. All three typechecks, Prettier, ESLint on the touched files and 325 tests pass. Repair round 5 (incomplete when its process was killed, completed and verified in repair round 6) addressed the verify-6 browser-QA failures. Group 1: the customer, device and order lists gained a region filter (previously only the dashboard had one) — the order list now sends region to GET /service-orders and the server filters visible orders, while the customer and device lists filter the fetched rows, deriving a device's region from its customer; /service-regions supplies the distinct values. Group 2: attachment preview was made robust — a valid XLSX that omitted the optional xl/styles.xml is completed before loading so the Office viewer no longer reports 'Unable to render this Office Open XML file.', and PDFs are rendered to canvases in the dialog's own document with pdfjs-dist instead of the browser's built-in viewer, which had navigated the tab to about:blank and dropped the session. Group 3: orders created from the report form now inherit their region from the device or, when the device has none, from its customer, and migration 202609010009 backfills the region of existing orders so the dashboard's region distribution covers every order. Repair round 6 confirmed each fix against the factory browser fixtures (raw vs normalized XLSX in headless Chromium, and the pdfjs canvas path on sample.pdf), added tests/logic/order-create-region.test.ts, removed a leftover staged .tmp-ooxml-test/ scratch directory, and reran Prettier, ESLint on the touched files, all three typechecks and the relevant logic tests (22 passed). Repair round 7 addressed the verify-7 browser-QA defect that the root/unrestricted account (nocobase) saw no options in the customer, device and order Region filters while its dashboard region filter was complete. Root cause: hasRole() short-circuits to true for isRoot, so the restricting predicates isCustomer/isIntegrator/isObserver all returned true for root; isCustomer then scoped those lists to caller.customerId (null for root) and returned empty, while /dashboard/summary checks isCoordinator first and therefore still listed every region. Fixed by adding hasExplicitRole() to server/services/access.ts and using it for isCustomer, isIntegrator and isObserver, so root is unrestricted rather than impersonating a restriction role; isCoordinator and isEngineer keep the root bypass. Added tests/logic/access-roles.test.ts pinning that root is a coordinator/writer/internal-field reader but not a customer, integrator or observer, and that explicit roles still match. Touched-file Prettier, ESLint and tsconfig.server typecheck pass, plus the four relevant logic test files (16 tests). Repair round 8 addressed the verify-8 browser-QA defect that the device and customer list search boxes did not reset pagination: an onChange that only called setSearch left the page on a now non-existent page, so a one-page result rendered as an empty page with the indicator showing "2 / 1". Both search handlers now also call setPage(1), matching the existing region/status filters, and a new tests/components/service-list-search-pagination.test.tsx renders both lists against fixed fixtures, moves to page 2, searches a code that lives on page 1 and asserts "1 / 1" with no "2 / 1". The new test, touched-file Prettier, ESLint and the client tsc typecheck pass. Repair round 9 addressed five verify-9 browser-QA defects. (1) The customer and device edit dialogs kept the values typed into a previous failed submission because they stay mounted across opens and merge local overrides over the newly selected record; each is now remounted per open session with a state-derived key, covered by tests/components/service-customer-form.test.tsx. (2) The reassign dialog had no reason field and the history recorded no reason: the dialog now requires a reason when the order already has an assignee, assignOrder() sends it, the server rejects a reassignment without one (400 assignReasonRequired) and writes the reason into the order log, covered by tests/components/order-assign-reason.test.tsx. (3) The customer Region field was not required and a blank value caused a NOT NULL 500 because customerValues() wrote an explicit null: the form validates it client-side with per-field feedback, the create route answers 400 customerRegionRequired, and an update that omits it leaves the stored value alone; covered by tests/logic/service-customer-region.test.ts. (4) The dashboard Knowledge articles count ignored article permissions (6 vs 5) because the dashboard never applied canReadArticle; a shared visibleArticles() helper now drives both the list and the count, covered by a new case in tests/logic/knowledge-sharing.test.ts. (5) The docx/pptx previews that the harness reported stuck on "Loading preview..." could not be reproduced under plain Chrome/Playwright, the real agent-browser CLI, CPU throttling or background-tab emulation; the strongest source difference (progressiveLayout, used only by docx/pptx while the working xlsx does not) was removed, the translator identity was stabilized through a ref, and a bounded 30s timeout now surfaces the real error instead of an endless spinner, covered by a fake-timer case in tests/components/file-preview.test.tsx. Touched-file Prettier, ESLint, the client and server typechecks and the 41 relevant tests pass; the docx/pptx path still needs a full browser re-verification.

问题 01 · format:check

Prettier rejected 5 newly written server files

本任务已处理

pnpm format:check '!.github/**' reported code style issues in server/routes/attachments.ts, server/routes/inspections.ts, server/routes/service-assistant.ts, server/routes/service-orders.ts and server/services/orders.ts.

原因（实现者自述）
The service-system server files were written without Prettier formatting; the per-file format:auto step in verify.sh only formats the files that stage considered changed, so the aggregate format:check later saw unformatted files.
处理方式
Ran prettier --write on the affected files (and later on the newly touched files) so pnpm format:check '!.github/**' passes.

问题 02 · lint

eslint no-base-to-string across server routes and services

本任务已处理

pnpm lint --ignore-pattern '.github/**' failed with about 102 no-base-to-string errors where String(value) or template interpolation was applied to RepositoryRecord field values.

原因（实现者自述）
RepositoryRecord is Record<string, RepositoryMutationScalarValue>; the value union includes objects and arrays, so String() on it can stringify '[object Object]' and eslint forbids it.
处理方式
Added a single toText(value: unknown): string helper in server/services/text.ts (null/undefined to '', strings as-is, number/bigint/boolean via String(), Date via toString(), otherwise '') and replaced the flagged stringifications across server routes and services. Verified String() on narrowed primitives is lint-safe.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 03 · lint

eslint no-unsafe-* after an earlier eslint --fix removed type assertions

本任务已处理

eslint server reported no-unsafe-assignment/member-access/call/return errors, concentrated in server/routes/service-assistant.ts.

原因（实现者自述）
An earlier eslint --fix removed type assertions that were actually load-bearing (for example the shape of app.config.get('ai')), leaving values typed as any that then flowed into property access and calls.
处理方式
Fixed forward rather than re-running --fix: reintroduced a runtime type guard isLlmServicesConfig for the LLM configuration and kept the surrounding values typed, so the assertions are no longer needed. pnpm lint --ignore-pattern '.github/**' passes.

问题 05 · lint

Seed lint errors: unbound-method and no-base-to-string

本任务已处理

database/main/seeds/202609010003_sample_data.ts failed lint with unbound-method on a destructured repository and no-base-to-string on seed record fields.

原因（实现者自述）
SeedContext.repository is a method, so destructuring it in the run signature detached it from this; and RepositoryRecord field values may be objects, so String(record.name) is unsafe.
处理方式
Changed the seed to run(context) and use context.repository(name) plus const { query } = context, and added a local text(value: unknown): string helper for the two stringified seed fields.

问题 06 · typecheck

TS2339 from .catch(() => ({})) fallback unions

本任务已处理

tsc -p tsconfig.server.json reported Property 'X' does not exist on type 'Record<string, unknown> | {}' in server/routes/inspections.ts, integrations.ts and service-assistant.ts.

原因（实现者自述）
A fetch JSON parse typed as .json<Record<string, unknown>>() chained with .catch(() => ({})) inferred a union with the empty object literal, so member access on the result was not allowed.
处理方式
Typed the fallback explicitly with .catch((): Record<string, unknown> => ({})) instead of using an as assertion, which would have tripped no-unnecessary-type-assertion. tsc -p tsconfig.server.json --noEmit passes.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json
问题 07 · test

Source-loaded seeds could not resolve sibling .js specifiers

本任务已处理

tests/logic/app-server.test.ts failed: Cannot find module '/workspace/database/seed-data/permission-sets.js' imported from database/main/seeds/202609010002_permission_sets.ts (and the same for '../../../server/roles.js').

原因（实现者自述）
The seed loader imports an application seed as TypeScript source, but Node type stripping does not rewrite a .js specifier to a sibling .ts file. The seeds were not self-contained: one imported database/seed-data/permission-sets.js and the other imported shared role and order-status constants from server/roles.js.
处理方式
Made both seeds self-contained by spelling the role keys, page ids, settings targets, user actions and order statuses out locally, then deleted database/seed-data/permission-sets.ts and updated the comment in client/routes.ts. This matches the rule that seeds are applied history and must not import a shared constant that keeps evolving.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json

原因（实现者自述）

Seed 202609010006_service_repairs now hands over SO-2026-0001 (non-confidential) to the collaborator and, on purpose, also shares the confidential SO-2026-0004 to demonstrate that sharing never reveals it, plus a matching in-box message. 问题 25 · browser-QA

POST /service-devices returned 500 because a blank category was written as null

本任务已处理

Creating a device failed with a server error whenever the Category field was left blank; editing an existing device still worked.

原因（实现者自述）
service_devices.category is NOT NULL with a database default ('通用设备'). The create handler always included a category key, writing null/undefined when the form omitted it, so SQLite rejected the insert with a NOT NULL constraint failure and the database default never applied.
处理方式
Extracted deviceCreateValues(body, customer) in server/routes/service-data.ts, which sets category only when a non-blank string is supplied and otherwise omits the column so the default applies. Confirmed on a copy of storage/database.sqlite that an explicit NULL insert fails (NOT NULL constraint failed: service_devices.category, exit 19) while omitting the column succeeds with the default; added tests/logic/service-device-create.test.ts for the blank, supplied and required-field cases.

原因（实现者自述）
The Base UI Select root renders SelectValue from its items prop. Application Selects passed only children, so the closed trigger fell back to the stored value rather than the translated label.

Added items={[{ value, label }]} to every application Select root (29 across client/pages and client/components/data-table-pagination.tsx), with labels from the service locale; shared option arrays where no name collision and inline arrays inside dialogs where shared consts would collide. 问题 31 · browser-QA

本任务已处理

原因（实现者自述）
The list pages drew their filters from status/priority/assignee/search only. The orders list had no region query parameter and the customer/device lists had no region option array, so region was a display-only table column.

Added a region Select to all three lists. 本任务已处理

A legitimate XLSX opened by the in-app Office viewer reported 'Unable to render this Office Open XML file.' and offered only Download; DOCX and PPTX previewed normally.

原因（实现者自述）
OOXML makes xl/styles.xml optional and the file omitted it, but the @silurus/ooxml WASM parser requires the part and threw 'entry not found: xl/styles.xml', so a valid package was treated as unreadable.

Added client/extensions/nocobase-file-component-ui/lib/ooxml-normalize.ts ensureSpreadsheetStyles(): for a readable spreadsheet zip that has xl/workbook.xml but no xl/styles.xml it adds a minimal default styles part plus the [Content_Types].xml override and workbook relationship, leaving any other file byte-identical. office-open-xml-preview.tsx applies it for format 'xlsx' before viewer.load. Reproduced the failure and the fix in a headless Chromium against the factory sample.xlsx (raw failed with 'entry not found: xl/styles.xml', normalized loaded OK); covered by tests/logic/ooxml-normalize.test.ts.

The PDF was handed to the browser's built-in viewer, a nested frame/URL the application does not own, so the frame could navigate away and a failure produced an empty page with no visible reason.

The report form chooses a customer and one of that customer's devices; the device carries no region and createServiceOrder wrote no region, so the created order had none and was omitted from byRegion (which filters out empty regions).

问题 35 · browser-QA

Root account saw no Region filter options because it was treated as a customer

本任务已处理

The root account nocobase (root) saw only "All regions" in the Region filter of the service order, customer and device lists, and GET /main/api/service-regions returned {"data":[]} for root, while the same account’s dashboard Region filter offered all regions.

原因（实现者自述）
hasRole() in server/services/access.ts returns true for every caller.isRoot, so isCustomer(root), isIntegrator(root) and isObserver(root) all matched. /service-regions (and the customer/device list handlers) filtered records with isCustomer(caller), scoping root to caller.customerId === null and yielding nothing. The dashboard region list was unaffected only because listVisibleOrders checks isCoordinator before isCustomer.
处理方式
Added a private hasExplicitRole() that checks caller.roles without the root bypass and used it for the restricting predicates isCustomer, isIntegrator and isObserver; isCoordinator and isEngineer keep the root bypass so root remains unrestricted. /service-regions now returns every region for root. Covered by tests/logic/access-roles.test.ts (root is coordinator/writer/internal-field reader, not customer/integrator/observer; explicit jobs still match). Prettier, ESLint and tsconfig.server typecheck pass on the touched files; 16 tests across the four relevant logic test files pass.

本任务已处理

原因（实现者自述）
The device and customer list search inputs only called setSearch(event.target.value). The page state stayed at its previous value, so when the query narrowed the rows below the current page the slice was empty while the indicator printed the stale page against the recomputed total.

The search onChange on both client/pages/devices/index.tsx and client/pages/customers/index.tsx now also calls setPage(1), the same reset the region and status filters already performed. 问题 37 · browser-QA

Customer/device edit form kept values from a previous failed submission

本任务已处理

After a New customer form failed validation (duplicate code STALE-CHECK), opening an existing customer (C-1001) for editing still showed the values typed into the failed attempt — the code field read STALE-CHECK instead of C-1001. The same happened on the device form.

原因（实现者自述）
CustomerFormDialog and DeviceFormDialog hold their typed overrides in local `values` state and the parent renders them unconditionally with `Dialog open={open}`. The component therefore stays mounted across opens, and `current = { ...seed, ...values }` merged the stale overrides over the newly selected record. Nothing cleared `values` when the record changed.
处理方式
The parent now remounts each dialog per open session with `key={formOpen ? (editing?.id ?? "new") : "closed"}` in client/pages/customers/index.tsx and client/pages/devices/index.tsx, so a fresh instance seeds from the record. An earlier reset-in-useEffect attempt was dropped because `react-hooks/set-state-in-effect` forbids it. Added tests/components/service-customer-form.test.tsx: fail a create, close, edit C-1001, assert code C-1001 and name Acme.

本任务已处理

原因（实现者自述）
Migration 202609010001_create_service_system.ts declares `service_customers.region` NOT NULL with default 华东, but the form FIELDS entry had no `required`, and customerValues() in server/routes/service-data.ts mapped an absent/blank region to an explicit `region: null`, which overrode the column default and violated the constraint.

client/pages/customers/index.tsx marks region required, validates required fields before submit with a per-field `role="alert"` and `aria-invalid`, and keeps `region` in the payload. server/routes/service-data.ts returns 400 customerRegionRequired on create when blank and, on update, now omits the key entirely (leaving the stored value unchanged) rather than writing null. The assign dialog in client/pages/orders/detail/order-actions.tsx only collected an engineer, assignOrder() sent only assigneeId, and the POST /service-orders/:id/assign handler in server/routes/service-orders.ts wrote a fixed `派单给 <name>` log line with no reason input.

问题 41 · browser-QA

DOCX and PPTX previews stayed on "Loading preview..." (not reproduced; hardened)

本任务已处理

The harness reported the docx and pptx attachments stuck on "Loading preview..." while png, pdf and xlsx rendered. The fixture fetched the correct bytes twice with HTTP 200 for docx/pptx during the run.

原因（实现者自述）
Not reproducible: the same built chunks rendered docx and pptx correctly under plain Chrome/Playwright, under the real agent-browser CLI, and under CPU throttling and background-tab emulation, so no single environment-owned cause could be confirmed. The strongest source-level difference is that docx/pptx passed `progressiveLayout: true` while the working xlsx viewer did not; progressiveLayout publishes layout only once the host is laid out and visible, which a hidden/unmeasured dialog host can postpone, leaving `load` pending. A t-identity change could also have destroyed the viewer mid-load through the effect dependency.
处理方式
Removed `progressiveLayout` from the docx and pptx options (matching xlsx), stabilized the translator through a ref updated in an effect so a locale/namespace identity change cannot abort an in-flight load, and added a bounded 30s timeout (OFFICE_LOAD_TIMEOUT_MS) that moves a never-settling viewer to the real error state instead of an endless spinner. Documented the observability gap rather than touching the harness. Added a fake-timer case to tests/components/file-preview.test.tsx asserting the timeout surface. Repeated full browser re-verification is still required.
影响 / 代价：未提供，不估算来源：Agent · retro.json

实现者补充建议

来自可选过程笔记，不代表已独立确认；相同建议引用上方评审，其余保留原文。

建议 01 · 验收机制

Verify script short-circuits after the first failing stage

可自动化

The reported failure was Prettier formatting on five files, but format:check runs early in .github/scripts/verify.sh, so lint, typecheck, test and build never ran in the failing job. Only after fixing formatting did the real failures surface, which made a one-line-looking repair a five-stage repair.

建议改动

Run all verification stages and report every failure in one pass (or run a cheap aggregate smoke stage first), so a repair agent sees the whole failure set instead of discovering it one stage at a time.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 02 · scaffolding

Catch a server-only dependency in devDependencies before the build

可自动化

@nocobase/cron was imported by server/providers/inspections.ts but listed only in devDependencies. Development and typecheck both succeeded; only the build's 'Verify server dependencies' step caught it, because that is when dist/package.json is generated.

建议改动

Expose the server-dependency check as its own fast lint-like command and run it during development (for example from typecheck or a pre-commit hook), so the mistake is reported at the edit that introduces it rather than at the end of the pipeline.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 03 · documentation

Seeds must be self-contained and cannot import sibling source modules

需人工判断

Both application seeds imported external modules with .js specifiers; the test suite loads seeds as TypeScript source, where Node type stripping does not rewrite .js to a sibling .ts. This is easy to miss because application server code uses the same .js-in-source convention successfully after compilation.

建议改动

State explicitly in the seeds/migrations guidance that a seed file must not import any application source module (including role or status constants) and must spell shared values out locally, with the source-loaded test failure as the reason.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 04 · 验收机制

Browser-QA criteria must be re-checked against the built artifact

需人工判断

Several verify-2 findings were already stale: OOXML/PDF attachment preview worked live, and order keyword search was present in source and bundle. Re-verifying each finding against the current build before rewriting code avoids repairing behaviour that already works and focuses effort on the real failures.

建议改动

Before repair, re-run the exact QA action against the current build and record the observed result; treat only reproduced failures as defects.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 05 · i18n

A large key set is easier to keep parity-checked in its own module

需人工判断

377 service.* keys spread into en-US/zh-CN as two LocaleResource-typed modules made English/Chinese parity a compile error and kept the base locale files small.

建议改动

For a feature with a large string set, keep its keys in a dedicated LocaleResource-typed module and spread them into the base locale, rather than growing the base file.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 06 · workflow

Source-managed workflows cannot be enabled without an administrator

需人工判断

WorkflowService exposes no enable method and materialized source workflows default to enabled:false, so an automatically firing workflow would require an admin API call that a seed or provider cannot legitimately make. The acceptance flow was therefore implemented as ordinary typed code with its own history records.

建议改动

When a requirement is to record the steps of an automatic process, prefer application-owned typed code plus audit/history rows over a workflow that cannot be enabled at install time.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 07 · authorization

A record-scope helper must enumerate every job, not just the restrictive ones

需人工判断

The collaborator/engineer scope was written before the observer existed, so the observer fell through to the most restrictive branch and silently saw nothing. The masking and write guards were correct but unobservable, which would have read as a broken page.

建议改动

When a role is added, add it to every scope list (visibility, field masking, and write) and cover each role with a visible positive and negative case, so a missing entry fails a check instead of producing an empty, plausible-looking result.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 08 · authorization

A registered subject type is not administrable without a selection

需人工判断

Inheritance worked end to end with only resolveFor/filterActive, but the permission workspace could not name a team until administration.selection was added. Runtime correctness and administrative usability are separate obligations of the same registration.

建议改动

Register every application subject type with both the resolution hooks and an administration selection, and verify the subject appears in the inspector options.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 09 · testing

Cover the values a create writes against each NOT NULL column

可自动化

The device create 500 was a NOT NULL violation caused by writing an explicit null for a field the form left blank, even though the column has a database default. No test exercised the values a create assembles, so the regression was only visible at runtime.

建议改动

Assemble a handler's insert/update values in an exported pure function and unit test the absent, blank and supplied cases for every NOT NULL/defaulted column, so a missing field is a test failure rather than a 500.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 10 · frontend

A Select without items silently shows the stored value

可自动化

Base UI's Select renders its closed trigger from the items prop. Omitting it compiles and typechecks, and only shows up at runtime as an id or enum being displayed, which is easy to miss across many forms and filters.

建议改动

Wrap the Select primitive so items is required (or so SelectValue falls back to a provided label renderer), and add a repository scan or lint rule that fails when an application Select has no items.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 11 · i18n

Server-produced text bypasses the client locale system

可自动化

Route handlers returned hard-coded Chinese sentences; the client already preferred the server message, so the user's chosen language was ignored for every rejected write, not only the one defect that was reported.

建议改动

Give the server its own locale resources and a semantic error-key helper by default, and check in tests that a rejection for each language differs from the key and from the other language.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 12 · frontend

An OOXML viewer can require parts the format marks optional

需人工判断

xl/styles.xml is optional per OOXML and a valid small-exporter file omitted it, but @silurus/ooxml requires the part and refused the whole document. The failure surfaced only as a generic 'unreadable file' message, which pointed at the file rather than at the viewer's stricter requirement.

建议改动

Before handing a document to a strict viewer, complete missing optional package parts (and keep a fixture that reproduces the sparse package), or choose a viewer that tolerates them.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 13 · frontend

Render previews in the application's own document

需人工判断

A PDF shown through the browser's built-in viewer lives in a nested frame the application cannot inspect, so a failure is an empty page and the frame can navigate away and take the session with it; an in-page canvas render produces a visible, localized reason.

建议改动

Prefer in-document rendering (canvas/HTML) for previews the application must be able to explain, reserving iframes for content that is genuinely third-party.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 14 · 验收机制

Reproduce a preview defect against the real viewer, not by reading code

可自动化

Both preview defects were settled by loading the factory fixtures in a headless browser: the raw XLSX failed with 'entry not found: xl/styles.xml' and the normalized one loaded, and the pdfjs path rendered the sample PDF. Reading the viewer options alone would not have proved the sparse package was the cause.

建议改动

For third-party viewer defects, add a small browser harness that loads the exact fixture and asserts the rendered result, and keep the fixture in the repository.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 15 · 验收机制

Repair scratch harnesses must be removed before handoff

可自动化

The previous repair left a staged .tmp-ooxml-test/ directory (index.html, main.js, sample.xlsx) in the repository; it was not gitignored and would have shipped with the application.

建议改动

Put repair scratch work under an ignored tmp/ directory (or delete and unstage it as the last step) and add .tmp-*/ to .gitignore so a scratch harness cannot be committed by accident.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 16 · authorization

A root/unrestricted bypass must not satisfy restricting role predicates

可自动化

hasRole() was written for permission checks, where root passing every job is intended, but isCustomer/isIntegrator/isObserver reused it to decide record scope, so root became every restriction role at once and the customer scope (null id) emptied three lists. The dashboard escaped notice because it checks coordinator first.

建议改动

Separate "may do this job" from "is this kind of subject": give granting predicates the root bypass and make restricting/scoping predicates check explicit role membership, and unit test each predicate for root.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 17 · frontend

A dialog that stays mounted across opens must reset its own draft state

可自动化

Two separate browser failures (a stale New-customer draft, and a device form) came from the same shape: a form dialog rendered once with a controlled `open` keeps local `values` between opens. A reset effect is the obvious fix but the repository ESLint config (react-hooks/set-state-in-effect) forbids setState in an effect body.

建议改动

When adding a form dialog, remount it per open session with a state-derived `key` (e.g. `formOpen ? record?.id ?? "new" : "closed"`) instead of resetting local state in an effect. Record the pattern in the frontend reference so new pages do not reintroduce it.

来源：Agent · retro.json

建议 18 · 验收机制

A preview that only fails inside the harness needs a bounded failure path and an artifact

需人工判断

The docx/pptx hang could not be reproduced outside the QA session; the only durable evidence was the fixture fetch log. A viewer that can hang leaves no diagnostic and no recovery for the user.

建议改动

For any async third-party renderer, add an explicit timeout that surfaces the real error state (and keeps the download fallback), and have the QA harness capture a screenshot plus the viewer console output when a preview stays on its loading placeholder.

来源：Agent · retro.json

      "detail": "Two separate browser failures (a stale New-customer draft, and a device form) came from the same shape: a form dialog rendered once with a controlled `open` keeps local `values` between opens. A reset effect is the obvious fix but the repository ESLint config (react-hooks/set-state-in-effect) forbids setState in an effect body.",
      "suggestedChange": "When adding a form dialog, remount it per open session with a state-derived `key` (e.g. `formOpen ? record?.id ?? \"new\" : \"closed\"`) instead of resetting local state in an effect. Record the pattern in the frontend reference so new pages do not reintroduce it.",
      "mechanizable": true
    },
    {
      "category": "verification",
      "title": "A preview that only fails inside the harness needs a bounded failure path and an artifact",
      "detail": "The docx/pptx hang could not be reproduced outside the QA session; the only durable evidence was the fixture fetch log. A viewer that can hang leaves no diagnostic and no recovery for the user.",
      "suggestedChange": "For any async third-party renderer, add an explicit timeout that surfaces the real error state (and keeps the download fallback), and have the QA harness capture a screenshot plus the viewer console output when a preview stays on its loading placeholder.",
      "mechanizable": false
    }
  ]
}

完整原始验收要求
以下仅为业务浏览器验收。逐条记录实际操作、观察、证据；模块代码/Skill 检查见独立评审评论，不能用页面通过代替代码评审，也不能要求浏览器 QA 伪造源码证据。

B01. 以主管、华东工程师、华南工程师、协作工程师、观察员分别登录，验证各自入口及允许/禁止的业务操作；角色切换不保留前一账号的权限。
B02. 新增客户和设备、编辑后刷新，验证值回填与保存；重复设备编号、无效客户设备关联有清晰反馈。
B03. 搜索、区域/状态筛选、分页、详情刷新和返回列表正常，结果不能混入无权访问的记录。
B04. 按草稿、提交、分派、处理、待确认、退回、再次处理、关闭跑通一张工单；验证转派/取消原因和关闭后的限制。
B05. 快速重复提交/关闭同一工单不产生重复业务结果；不能跳过必要状态直接关闭。
B06. 实际上传 PNG、PDF、DOCX、XLSX、PPTX 小型合法文件并保存业务关联；逐格式检查显示的内容而非文件名，刷新后重新预览、下载；损坏或不支持的文件给出失败提示。文件测试样例由测试准备生成或提供，不能把浏览器 QA 自行生成文件当成浏览器操作。
B07. 用无工单访问权的普通用户尝试打开工单及其附件，不能显示内容；观察员看不到内部成本字段且不能编辑。
B08. 默认知识可读范围、指定工单跨区分享、分享撤销、保密限制分别生效；分享不能自动授予原本没有的操作。
B09. 分派后收件人消息中心出现对应持久消息，可跳转、已读/未读、删除；刷新/重新登录后状态正确，其他用户看不到；断开再恢复连接后可补齐消息。
B10. 保存成功、必填校验和一次真实失败都有正确的即时反馈，失败后未保存内容可恢复，不以 toast 冒充站内信。
B11. 从自动受理的执行记录查看步骤与实际工单结果；失败场景保留失败原因，恢复不删除旧记录或重复通知。
B12. 管理员查看巡检/超期计划，使用测试环境提供的短周期或受控触发观察实际执行；执行结束时业务结果一致，重复执行不重复创建当天巡检；停用后不再产生新任务。
B13. 看板数值与当前用户能看到的工单一致，状态变更和筛选后更新；不同岗位不出现越权统计。
B14. 管理员创建、停用、重新启用测试用户并维护岗位；停用后的原会话不可继续使用，其他业务账户不受影响。只读业务管理员可查看数据结构，但不能改表。
B15. 切换中英文，逐页检查导航、字段、弹窗、文件组件、消息及错误反馈；刷新/直接地址访问正常，不能只有中文静态页面。
B16. 服务助手未配置时准确提示且手工流程正常；配置测试模型的扩展轮次才验证真实问答、上下文范围、建议草稿、确认/拒绝和对话恢复。外部通知同理：没有测试服务标为扩展场景未执行，不声称实投成功。

API 密钥的 HTTP 调用、服务端越权/幂等、代码边界、安装引导和 Hub 发布属于独立集成/模块评审，不将它们冒充浏览器截图验收。测试角色账号可通过管理员 UI 创建，统一使用本轮测试密码配置；测试准备缺失、基础环境失败与真实业务缺陷分别报告。
